sentences.text: Alligatorium is a member of the class Reptilia.
The type species A. meyeri was named in 1871 based on a single specimen found in Cerin, eastern France.
Two other nominal species from Bavaria were later synonymized, with A. franconicum having priority.
A 2016 review removed A. franconicum from the genus Alligatorium and placed it in Neosuchia incertae sedis.
The species A. depereti, described in 1915, was reassigned to the separate genus Montsecosuchus in 1988.
This animal belongs to the family Atoposauridae.
It lived during the Kimmeridgian stage, between 154.8 and 149.2 million years ago.
